title: Percentile Index Mosaic and Regional Aperture for Route/Model Latency
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Provide a compact, queryable percentile matrix and regional aperture view that surfaces p95 and p99 latency regressions across route/model/region slice keys and feeds automated regression detectors. This ticket delivers the metrics rollup, dashboard panels, and alerting/playbook needed to operationalize percentile-driven regressions for inference workloads.

Scope includes:
- Metrics pipeline: add tdigest-derived rollups and decay windows (1m, 5m, 1h) keyed by route, model, region, instance_type, and batch_size.
- Instrumentation: ensure bench harness emits tokens/sec and full latency histograms; tag synthetic and production traces.
- Dashboard: percentiles matrix (rows: routes, cols: models) with regional small-multiples. Include waterfall breakdown panels for scheduling vs kernel vs KV-cache contributions.
- Regression detection: EWMA baseline + significance testing on p95 and p99, configurable thresholds by route-class; generate 'regression' incidents and link to playback traces.
- Backfill: 30d backfill of aggregations at 1h granularity for historical baselines.
- Backward compatibility: new metrics names are prefixed percentiles.v2 to avoid collision and allow phased swaps.

Non-goals: changing core serving kernel code or autoscaling semantics; those live in separate follow-ups.

Implementation notes: we'll compute tdigest summaries in the metrics aggregator service (metrics-tiler) then materialize percentile values into ClickHouse/TimeSeries with rollup keys. Use deterministic bucketing for region/model/route to keep cardinality bounded. Alerts will be managed through the observability pipeline with a regression watcher that emits runbooks and suggested mitigations (scale-up fallback, model-fallback).
acceptance_criteria: tdigest rollup exported for p50/p75/p90/p95/p99 on route/model/region instance_type batch_size at 1m and 5m windows
dashboard with percentile matrix and regional small-multiples is accessible in Console with a route/model selector and time-range controls

30d backfill completed for a selected 5 high-traffic routes and validated against raw traces
